about_the_game:
Welcome to the pixel world of FISHTOPIA where you can nurture wondrous creatures of all shapes and sizes. Your aquatic friends thrive even when you're offline! Meet hundreds of unique deep-sea dwellers to fill your Creaturepedia. Mix and match decorations across vibrant themes to craft your one-of-a-kind seascape. Keep exploring and discover the mysteries hidden in the depths.

Exquisite Pixel Art Graphic

  • Retro CRT-style pixel art with a modern twist, vibrant and full of charm

  • Swap between themed underwater scenes and decorate freely to build your dream seascape

  • Dynamic wallpaper mode: Your FISHTOPIA thrives on-screen, day or night

A Rich Variety of Cards Await Your Collection

  • 12 card types hidden across 5 unique zones, each with its own surprises

  • 300+ quirky sea creatures and 100+ decorative items to collect and showcase

  • Unlock new species and their variants to fill out your Creaturepedia

Relaxing & Joyful Interactive Raising Experience

  • Multiple lofi tracks, infused with a synthwave vibe, immerse you in a deep-sea journey

  • Enjoy maximum joy with minimal effort as you raise pets through simple taps

  • Your aquatic friends thrive even when you're offline (offline progression)

short_description: FISHTOPIA is a pixel art style casual game blending idle gameplay with card collection. Discover 12 card types with special effects, featuring 300+ unique creatures and 100+ decorative items. Mix and match vibrant themes to craft your cyberpunk aquatic world.
